module: Editor Tree Spline tool: you draw an editable polyline on the terrain and the tool plants a regular row of trees/shrubs (real Forest instances) along it (avenues, hedges). From 2 nodes, the spline plants and replants live when you add/move/delete nodes or change the distribution. "Line" sibling of forestZoneEditor; shares the core of toolUtilities/foliageScatter. Same structure as meshSpline/assemblySpline (editor/<tool>.lua + <tool>/splineMgr.lua + populate.lua). "treeSpline" window and treeSplineEditMode edit mode.
notes: Constants: spacing 0.5 to 40 m, position variance 0 to 1, scale variance 0 to 0.9, max slope 0 to 89°, max seed 100000, RDP simplification tolerance 4 m.
A locked spline (isEnabled = false) keeps its trees in the forest when the level is saved and on serialization; only active splines are removed/lifted.
setSelectedSplineIdx and setSelectedNodeIdx must exist as a pair, otherwise splineInput ignores the cross-tool selection.

setSelectedSplineIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected spline; called by splineInput on a jump to this tool.

setSelectedNodeIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected node; called by splineInput on a jump to this tool.

setLockedById.desc: Locks/unlocks the tree spline with the given identifier (isEnabled = not isLocked), marks it dirty and replants it immediately. Also used by the Master Spline for linked children. The trees of a locked spline stay in the forest on save. No effect if the id is unknown.

onSerialize.desc: Before the Lua VM reload: for each locked spline, keeps the keys of its trees (keptObjects via populate.release), then takes a snapshot of the definitions and removes the planted instances to avoid orphans. onDeserialized replants them.

onDeserialized.desc: After reload: restores the state (splines marked dirty, replanted at the next onEditorGui).

onEditorGui.desc: Editor frame hook: puts back the lifted trees, replants dirty splines (even when the tool is inactive), draws the window, handles node editing via splineInput and the rendering of splines.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: creates editor.editModes.treeSplineEditMode and registers the treeSpline window (330x760).

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: forgets the lifted trees and deletes all splines.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Before the level is saved: lifts from the forest (scatter.lift) the trees of active splines so they are not written; only the trees of locked splines are part of the level. They are put back on the next frame.
